findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no soap or paper towel available at the back room hand sink. The PIC was informed and both dispensers were refilled. Ensure hand sinks are properly supplied at all times to promote frequent hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a Purell alcohol-based sanitizing solution in use without a proper testing device to confirm product concentration. The PIC was informed that Purell test strips must be purchased in order to continue use of this product on food-contact surfaces. Instead, the PIC created a bleach solution that measured 100ppm with a test strip. This bottle was clearly labeled as bleach sanitizer spray.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(D) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (D) If another solution of a chemical specified under (A) - (C) of this section is used, the PERMIT HOLDER shall demonstrate to the REGULATORY AUTHORITY that the solution achieves SANITIZATION and the use of the solution shall be APPROVED.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16: Observed wet mop head stored head down in mop bucket. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed walls in soda fountain area to need coving installed. Install coving as needed. 

6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed glass of display coolers and floors inside display cooler to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean display cooler glass and floors. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment: 3-302.11: (A) Observed metal stirring implement of Freal milkshake machine to be heavily soiled with food splash and debris. Clean and santize stirring implement of Freal machine. Machine has been removed from service until it has been cleaned and sanitized. (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-602.12: (A) Observed interior cavity of microwave below popcorn machine to be heavily soiled with food splash and debris. Clean and sanitize interior cavity of microwave. The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed ice catch wells of fountain soda machines to be soiled with slimy residue. Clean and sanitize ice catch wells.
2) Observed tea residue present underneath tea machines in hot drink area. Clean and sanitize under tea machines.
3) Observed soda syrup on floor in front of soda syrup boxes in back room. Clean up soda syrup.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16: Observed wet mop head stored head down in mop bucket. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 
Hand sink at main island is not supplied with hand soap. Hand soap was provide to this hand sink.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-202.16: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. 
Counter tops at the islands are cracked and chipped. The area around the sink base of the hand sink is also uneven and in disrepair. These areas are no longer considered to be smooth or easily cleanable. Repair or replace the counters that are chipped, raw and areas that are no longer easily cleanable.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-205.11: Observed hand washing sink in back room to be blocked by boxes.  Boxes were moved.(A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment: 3-307.11: Observed Freal milkshake in freezer with no lid, exposing contents to contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301-3-306.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: 4-903.11: Observed boxes of single service cups stored directly on the ground in the back storage room. (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on soda machine catch tray around where the metal grate sits on the plastic tray. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13. Clean and maintain free of soil accumulation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11  (C) Equipment was found in disrepair in the food area under the cabinets and counter tops. The base cabinets and the cabinet tops at the coffee bar are in gross disrepair. There are areas where the cabinet is disintegrating around the hand sink. Under the cabinets the coating is warn off past repair and allows the surfaces to be absorbent and no longer easily clean able. Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.  Reference 6-501.11. Repair or replace

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Observed dispenser straw from cream half and half dispenser to be storing food at room tempertuare. Make sure to cut the straw portion at a 45 degree angle to facilitate draining so that food is not stored at room temperature. Observed foods in fresh food cooler to have inernal temperautres of between 47F and 50F.  Foods were removed and wasted. 750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed cardboard to be used as a non food surface. Remove cardboard from around tea dispensers and replace with smooth clean able material. Also, sugar and sweetener packs are observed to be stored in stir straw boxes. Replace these holders with smooth clean able containers. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: Observed the sanitizer bucket to be out of concentration. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer between uses. 750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the ice tea dispenser spouts, and the back of the ice chute at the soda fountain area are soiled. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: Observed one of the cans in the women's rest room to have no cover. Provide covered cans. 750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily clean able, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Observed floors in the back under soda machines, along walls and in corners to be soiled with litter and debris. 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment: 750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 135°F or above  while on display and service. Observed hot dogs and tornados at 125 and 115 respectively in separate roller bins. Discussed with the PIC who promptly turned the temp up in the 2 locations.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment: 750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection. Observed an open can having been drunk from in the walk in cooler stored on shelves next to products for service. Discussed with the PIC and the can was moved during the inspection.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory. Observed no soap at the hand sink in the island on the customer floor. All hand sinks used for hand washing should have warm running water, soap and a drying method. Discussed with the PIC who said the machine they have had recently broken and another was ordered. Instructed them that sinks need soap at all times and a hand soup would be provided.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: 750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food. Observed mop head stored in the mop bucket. Instructed PIC that it needs to be stored in a fashion so that it hangs. The PIC stated that the current hanging system had broken and has replacements already ordered. Discussed other ways to store it in the mean time and instructed to move.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.citation_text:
750.230 - Facility had only an infrared thermometer for checking food temperatures. GM and staff were advised on the use of a metal stem thermometer for checking food temperatures. Purchase and use stem thermometers.

A calibratable metal-stemmed thermometer accurate to ±2F° shall be provided for checking temperatures on food.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - Tube of half and half was cut straight across. Product was puddling in the tube. Cut creamer dispensing tubes at an angle to allow product to drain from the tube and not puddle at ambient temperature between uses.

Food shall be properly stored and protected at all times.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.510 & 512 - Employee was observed preparing to put on gloves to package cookies without first washing hands. Employee stated she washed her hands out front prior to making tea. In the meantime. other surfaces were touched, and hands needed to be washed. Staff were advised on washing hands before putting on gloves and between glove changes. The employee washed her hands prior to putting on a fresh pair of gloves to continue with food handling.

Employees shall properly wash their hands any time hands may have been contaminated and prior to putting on gloves, between glove changes, and prior to working with food, clean equipment, and unwrapped single service articles.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
750.-810 - Sani-bukcet contained a solution of Dawn dish soap and bleach based on information provided. Solution was at 0ppm chlorine. Solution was emptied from the bucket, and the bucket was cleaned. A new solution of bleach water was prepared at proper concentration (200ppm).

Moist cloths used for wiping general surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses. Maintain bleach solutions in the sani-bucket at 100-200ppm. Do not mix bleach water with any other chemicals, including dish soap. Use luke warm water to make the solution, and use test strips to verify the solution is at proper concentration. Change solutions every 2 to 4 hours or more frequently if solution and/or wiping cloths become heavily soiled.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) F'real milkshake wand (food splash);   and
B) pizza oven (food debris).

Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed, up to every 4hrs after continuous use (i.e. tongs; milkshake wand; etc.), to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
(R) 750.880 - Coffee filters were observed sitting out on top of the coffee bean grinder in the food service area with food contact surfaces exposed.  Store filters in the original package covered and/or in a clean covered container.

Single service articles shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination. Store items in sealed, food grade bags or containers and/or inverted with food contact surfaces face down on top of clean surfaces.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Back handsink was blocked with boxes upon arrival of inspector. Boxes were removed from the top edge of the sink.

Handsinks are to be accessible at all times to allow for proper handwashing. Do not black the handsink for any reason. Do not store items in the basin or on the edge of the handsink.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
(R) 750.1120 - A) Paper towels were not available at the back handsink. Paper towels were provided during the inspection. 
Maintain supplies of soap and paper towels at handsinks to allow for proper handwashing at all times.

B) Back handsink was soiled with buildup/splash in the basin, around the faucet, and along surfaces on top of the sink. 
Clean handsinks and related fixtures as needed, and maintain them clean.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1200. & 1220 - A)  Floor in the back room along the floor to wall juncture was soiled with general debris and buildup, especially under the fountain drink machines and in the corner to the left of the machine. Evidence of old rodent activity was also noted behind the marquee letter cubby.
Maintenance worker began cleaning in the area during the inspection. This same area was observed to have noticeable damage on the lower wall (see #37 below).

B) Plastic baseboard was loose along the wall and in the corner to the left of the fountain soda machines in the back room. Provide proper repairs after thoroughly cleaning in the area (see general comments).

Floors shall be kept clean, and junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.12210 - A) (R) Walls on both sides of mopsink were damaged. Left side had crumbling drywall that was starting to fall apart. Right side had a hole in it.
Repair the walls.

B) 1. Wall tiles were missing and/or cracked along the ledge where brewed tea dispensers were located.
2. Tiles were missing along the wall beneath the fountain drink machines. GM noted maintenance is aware of the issue, and the wall tiles are on the list of things to fix.
Repair/replace the missing and damaged wall tiles.

C) The bottom part of the wall was damaged beneath the storage racks under the fountain drink machines in the back room. GM noted maintenance is area of the issue, and the wall repairs are on the list of things to fix. Repair the wall.
 
Walls must be in good repair, constructed to facilitate easy cleaning, and maintained clean.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.citation_text:
750.130 & 160 - A) 1. Raw bacon was stored above ready to eat foods in the reach-in cooler section. Bacon was moved to the bottom shelf with shell eggs below all ready to eat foods.
2. Raw meats (chicken; beef & pork patties; ribeye; bacon; brats) were stored above burritos, pizza rolls, and sandwiches in the reach-in freezer section. Foods were rearranged so all raw products were stored in proper order below other foods.

All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a ay from raw foods. 
Raw meat shall be properly stored, in the order of cooking requirements with the highest required temperature product on the bottom (raw poultry) and all other meats stored based on cooking requirements/cuts of meat.

B) Surfaces around and on the mixing wand of the F'real milkshake machine were soiled with buildup of dried milkshake splash and dust (far back corner). GM cleaned and sanitized the machine during the inspection.
**The food contact surfaces of the milkshake machine must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized up to every 4hrs after continuous use**

Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - Chlorine and Quat test strips were not available for checking sanitizer concentrations at the 3 part sink (Steramine quat tablets used for ware washing) or in sani-buckets (bleach solutions used for wiping surfaces). Obtain and use test strips for checking sanitizer concentrations.

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of each chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solutions in parts per million.
NOTE: F'real machine requires an iodine solution for sanitizing step. Iodine test kit was present with the F'real sanitizing kit.**

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - A) Sani-bucket solution tested at 0ppm chlorine. Solution was remade (200ppm).

B) Wet wiping cloth was observed on the coffee counter. Wet wiping cloth was placed back in the sani-bucket.

Maintain sanitizer solutions at 100-200ppm chlorine. Change solutions ever 2 to 4 hours or more frequently if solutions and wiping cloths become heavily soiled.
Store wiping cloths in sanitizer solution between uses to inhibit the growth of microorganisms. 
Use test strips to verify sanitizer is at proper concentration.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text:
750.880 - Coffee filters and paper food boats were observed on top of equipment in the food service area with food contact surfaces exposed. 

Single service articles shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination. Store items in sealed, food grade bags or containers and/or inverted with food contact surfaces face down on top of clean surfaces.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.citation_text:
750.1310 - Box of d-CON was observed on top of the ice machine. Box was moved to the floor over by the 3 part sink.
NOTE: No chemicals should be stored on top of the ice machine. Bags of ice are prepared in the area, and there is a chance of chemical contamination.
 
All toxic items must be properly stored, away from food and all food related items (i.e. clean equipment, single service articles), to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.citation_text:
750.1300 - Spray bottles were observed without proper labels in the following areas:
A) under front food counter handsink (clear liquid);
B) on drain board of 3 part sink (blue liquid - appeared to be window cleaner);  and
C) hanging above drain board of 3 part sink (green liquid in 2 bottles).
Labels were placed on bottles during the inspection.

Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Maintain proper labels on containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: No thermometer in the cream dispenser. 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F. Thermometer was added to the cream dispenser. Suggest adding independent thermometer to open front case.

Seal counter to wall and seal areas on counter near hand sink that are raw.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Food contact surfaces observed soiled at time of inspection are: 1) coffee maker spouts 2) sugar container pour spouts 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. Ensure that all surfaces that come into contact with food are washed rinsed and sanitized any time they  may have become contaminated.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Box of cups on the floor in the dry storage area. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law. Move these cups up off of the floor.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: No towels at the food prep hand sink in the island upon arrival. 750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory. Hand towels were placed at the hand sink.

findings.comment: The sandwich hot holding unit does not contain a thermometer. 750.150(a) All hot units that contain potentially hazardous foods shall contain  a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F Provide a thermometer so that the temperature can be monitored.

1.Observed boxes of cups lids and plastic cutlery on the floor.  Store at least 6" above the floor.
2.Observed unprotected coffee filters.  Keep the coffee filters covered.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed an accumulation of soil on the floor in the corner of the walk in beer cooler next to the cases of Bud Light bottles.  Clean the floor and maintain clean.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: Observed several unlabeled spray bottles of cleaners.  Label all secondary containers.  Corrected:  The bottles were labeled.
findings.citation_text: 750.1300 - Properly label poisonous or toxic materials.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed all hot items on the rollers not at the proper holding temperature.  Items were placed on the rollers at approximately 12:30pm today.  Temperatures of the items were taken at approximately 3:00pm.  Hot hold potentially hazardous food at 135F or greater.  Corrected: food was voluntarily discarded.
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 135°F or above while on display and service.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed the thermometer in the cream cold holding unit not properly operating.  Provide a conspicuously operating thermometer in each cooler.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed bacon above juice drinks.  Store ready to eat food above food requiring cooking.  Corrected: Items were rearranged.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Repeat:  Did not observe soap or towels at the hot food island hand sink.  Provide soap and towels at each hand sink.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.
